- 
- Top Performer: Carousel supports strong CTR, often outperforming other placements by 2x
- High Impact and Rotational: Own 100% SOV of all TVs or leverage Targeted Rotational Carousel Video
- Video-First: enables standard 16:9 Trailers within the Carousel Companion to expand reach
- Custom Animated Creative: 3D Custom Carousel animation effects, Countdown Clock, etc.
